trip.name: Six Across Japan
trip.notes: Wife 29 weeks pregnant at departure, ~32 weeks at return. New Year closures ~29 Dec–4 Jan. Travel peaks 29–31 Dec and 2–4 Jan; 9–11 Jan Nozomi all-reserved.

places.name: Tokyo
places.blurb: Asakusa and Yanaka old town, Tsukiji outer market, depachika food halls, Christmas Eve lights.
places.winter: Dry, sunny, 3–11°C. Best Fuji views from rooftops.
places.bump: Big stations mean lots of walking. Two taxis fit six.

places.name: Kamakura
places.blurb: Great Buddha, bamboo temple, seaside day trip from Tokyo.
places.bump: Some temple stairs; the Great Buddha is flat.

places.name: Lake Kawaguchiko
places.blurb: Ryokan with Fuji-view rooms, Oishi Park, Oshino Hakkai spring village, Chureito Pagoda.
places.winter: Clearest Fuji of the year, -5 to 8°C, early mornings best.
places.bump: Chureito has ~400 steps; the lakeside is flat.

places.name: Hakone
places.blurb: Mountain train, ropeway over Owakudani sulphur vents, Lake Ashi boat, Open-Air Museum, onsen ryokan.
places.winter: Fuji visible on clear mornings; ropeway can pause in wind.
places.bump: Easy loop with seated transport.

places.name: Matsumoto
places.blurb: Original black castle. Lunch stop between Fuji and Takayama.
places.bump: Castle interior stairs are very steep; grounds are flat.

places.name: Takayama
places.blurb: Edo-period merchant streets, morning markets, sake breweries, Hida beef, Hida Folk Village.
places.bump: Flat old town; icy lanes, bring cleats.

places.name: Shirakawa-go
places.blurb: UNESCO village of thatched gassho farmhouses, often under a metre of snow. Farmhouse inns available.
places.winter: Deep snow. 2027 light-up nights (11, 17, 24, 31 Jan) fall after the trip.
places.bump: Shared baths and steep stairs in farmhouse inns; ask for ground floor.

places.name: Kanazawa
places.blurb: Kenroku-en garden with snow ropes, Higashi Chaya geisha district, Omicho market snow crab, samurai district.
places.winter: Wet and snowy, 1–8°C. Snow crab season.
places.bump: Flat, compact city.

places.name: Yudanaka / Shibu Onsen
places.blurb: Lantern-lit onsen street with nine public baths. Base for the snow monkeys.
places.bump: Choose a ryokan with private baths.

places.name: Jigokudani Snow Monkeys
places.blurb: Wild macaques bathing in a hot spring, reached by a 1.6 km forest path.
places.winter: Peak season for monkeys in the water.
places.bump: Flat but icy path, ~30 min each way. Decide on the day.

places.name: Nagano (Zenko-ji)
places.blurb: Major temple with a pitch-dark underground passage; Obuse chestnut town nearby.
places.bump: Easy.

places.name: Kyoto
places.blurb: Temples, Nishiki Market, tea ceremony, Arashiyama. New Year's Eve bell at Chion-in and Okera-mairi fire at Yasaka.
places.bump: Rent a whole machiya. Fushimi Inari lower gates only.

places.name: Uji
places.blurb: Byodo-in temple and the home of Japanese green tea.
places.bump: Flat.

places.name: Nara
places.blurb: Deer park, Todai-ji Great Buddha, Kasuga lanterns.
places.bump: Flat park paths.

places.name: Koyasan
places.blurb: Mountain monastery town. Temple lodging, morning chanting and fire ritual, Okunoin forest cemetery.
places.bump: Cold corridors. Pick a temple with heated rooms.

places.name: Osaka
places.blurb: Dotonbori, Kuromon market, Shinsekai kushikatsu, base for Nara and Himeji.
places.bump: Easy base near KIX for the flight home.

places.name: Himeji Castle
places.blurb: Japan's best-preserved original castle.
places.bump: Steep stairs inside; grounds are easy.

places.name: Hiroshima
places.blurb: Peace Memorial Park and museum, okonomiyaki.
places.bump: Flat.

places.name: Miyajima
places.blurb: Island shrine with the floating torii. Quiet at night after day visitors leave. Oyster season.
places.bump: Flat waterfront; the mountain ropeway is optional.

places.name: Yufuin
places.blurb: Onsen town known for ryokan with private open-air baths. Morning mist on Kinrin Lake.
places.bump: Private baths are standard here.

places.name: Beppu
places.blurb: Steaming hot-spring 'hells' and steam-cooked food.
places.winter: Steam is most dramatic in cold air.
places.bump: Easy, drivable between sites.

places.name: Nagasaki
places.blurb: Dejima, Glover Garden, Peace Park, Inasayama night view, champon and castella.
places.bump: Hilly; Glover Garden has outdoor escalators.

places.name: Fukuoka
places.blurb: Hakata ramen, yatai stalls, motsunabe. Fly home from FUK.
places.bump: Flat, compact.

places.name: Dazaifu
places.blurb: Major shrine with umegae mochi street.
places.bump: Flat.

places.name: Yanagawa
places.blurb: Canal boat rides with a heated kotatsu table in winter; steamed eel.
places.bump: Seated, easy.

places.name: Tsumago (Kiso Valley)
places.blurb: Edo-period post town on the Nakasendo. 8 km walk from Magome.
places.bump: Van meets walkers; she can skip the walk.

places.name: Ise
places.blurb: Ise Jingu, Japan's most sacred shrine, and the Oharai-machi pilgrim street.
places.winter: Huge crowds 1–3 Jan; late Dec is calmer.
places.bump: Flat gravel paths.

places.name: Kawayu Onsen (Kumano)
places.blurb: Sennin-buro river bath (Dec–Feb), Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Kodo walks, Nachi Falls.
places.winter: Cold; the river bath only runs in winter.
places.bump: Shallow bath; walk only the last stretch of the Kodo.

places.name: Kinosaki Onsen
places.blurb: Canal onsen town with seven public baths; snow crab season. Alternative New Year base.
places.bump: Most inns have private baths.

places.name: Sapporo & Otaru
places.blurb: Deep snow, seafood markets, miso ramen, Otaru canal.
places.bump: Icy pavements: highest fall risk.

places.name: Ginzan Onsen
places.blurb: Wooden onsen inns on a gas-lamp street under snow.
places.bump: Hard to book; stairs in old inns.

places.name: Nikko
places.blurb: Toshogu shrine in cedar forest, yuba dishes, Kegon Falls.
places.bump: Many stone stairs at the shrine.

places.name: Naoshima
places.blurb: Art island with Tadao Ando museums.
places.bump: Easy by bus.

routes.name: Grand Loop
routes.title: Fuji, the Alps and a Kyoto New Year

stays.leg: Fuji Excursion ltd express from Shinjuku, ~2 h
Nohi bus with 2–3 h stop in Shirakawa-go
Hokuriku shinkansen + Thunderbird via Tsuruga, ~2 h 15 (peak day)

routes.name: Snow Country
routes.title: Snow monkeys, onsen towns and a mountain New Year

stays.leg: Via Tokyo + shinkansen to Nagano + local train, ~4–5 h
Hida express + shinkansen via Nagoya, ~3.5 h

routes.name: Southwest
routes.title: Hakone, Hiroshima and a Kyushu onsen New Year

stays.leg: Shinkansen to Hakata + Yufuin no Mori, ~4 h

routes.name: Sacred Mountains
routes.title: Old roads, Ise and a monastery New Year

stays.leg: Fuji Excursion, ~2 h; pick up van 25 Dec
